experiment.name: all18-jev-v3-sentence-pass
experiment.notes: Jev rough cut, sentence pass only (arm jev_a, trim-trigger t_trim 0.3). Exported by scripts/jev_real/roughcut_jev_export.py in the skell-e-router repo from roughcut-jev-all18-v3-decisions.jsonl; no model calls were made to build this file and no Jev call is needed to rescore it. The cut is three Jev passes: a retake pass that cuts the losing take of a repeated line, a 0-5 keep score per sentence, and an edge-trim question per side whose answer becomes keep_words when Jev puts less than 0.3 on keeping the sentence whole. 293 of 8943 sentences carry a word range. SENTENCE POINTS and WORD SCORE are native here, not backfilled. Retake overrides: see episodes[*].retake_overrides.

source.merged_note: fit six + held-out twelve; greco-2.2-thumbnailing excluded (not on the published ladder)

missing_fields.raw_responses_file: no raw text sidecar: Jev returns a probability distribution over fixed options, not free text. The per-sentence distributions are in roughcut-jev-all18-v3-decisions.jsonl in the skell-e-router repo.
missing_fields.disagreements: the top-20 disagreement list is built by a private helper in roughcut_bench.experiments and nothing reads it off a result file; omitted rather than reimplemented.
missing_fields.run_ratings[*].category: Jev answers a score and a retake verdict, never a category; the category here is derived from the score.
